content.thinking: Invoices 802 and 803 appear to be duplicate rent entries under different numbers, and nothing seems posted after close based on period dates. Next I'll check AP journals in closed periods for post dates or invoice dates after close and out-of-sequence journal numbers, then verify the GL accrual imbalance mentioned in the notes.

input.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."MEMO", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."JRNL_NO" in (2474,2475,2473,1367,1368,2245,2221)

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO", p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_DT", h."POST_DT" from "APINVH" i left join "APPAYM" p on p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" limit 20
select h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", p."PAY_DT", p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_AMT" from "GLJRNH" h join "APPAYM" p on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where h."POST_DT"<>p."PAY_DT" limit 20
